summary: Creates a reusable skill for SEC 13F filing analysis. The trace shows a fund snapshot extraction task where the agent had to fuzzy-match manager names (finding Headlands Technologies for Renaissance Technologies query), classify stock-like vs non-stock holdings, and aggregate AUM data. The skill bundles the normalization/matching logic, stock classification rules, and data extraction workflow to prevent re-discovery of the Levenshtein matching and TSV parsing patterns. The verifier failed, so the skill includes explicit validation steps and troubleshooting for common data mismatches.
